issues.explanation: The editor_note_fa cites only 'INSO 42001 بند 3.21' but the entry carries two source-specific definitions (INSO 42001 §3.21 and INSO 23728 §3.1.5). A reader reading only the editor note would not know the term is also defined in INSO 23728 with a different, system-monitoring sense.
issues.suggested_fix: Change editor_note_fa to: «اصطلاح تعریف‌شده در INSO 42001 بند 3.21 (مدیریت مخاطره) و INSO 23728 بند 3.1.5 (پایش سامانه)؛ بازبینی‌نشده.»

issues.explanation: Rule 1 requires the preferred_fa to equal exactly what the standard prints. The printed evidence shows term_fa_printed as «داده‌شارها (جریان داده)» — the parenthetical is part of the printed term entry. The proposed entry demotes this full printed form to alternatives_fa and elevates the truncated «داده‌شارها» to preferred_fa, violating the rule.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to «داده‌شارها (جریان داده)» to match the printed form exactly. The standalone «داده‌شارها» may be retained as a separate alias in alternatives_fa if desired.
